content_blocks.text: The old house on Maple Street had always been a source of whispers and speculation. Tonight, as the moonlight bathed its ivy-covered walls in silvery light, it seemed to breathe with an eerie life of its own. Inside, the air was thick with the scent of aged wood and forgotten stories. As Evelyn stepped into the dimly lit foyer, the creaking floorboards under her feet echoed through the empty halls, carrying her back to a time when secrets were whispered and kept hidden.
